headline: Passage Lines Shatter Under Renewed Clashes Across Contested Fronts
war_summary: Since the previous dispatch, Callahan’s Passage has broken wide open, recording five strategic base transitions in the last two hours alone alongside more than 5,800 fresh casualties as fighting engulfed The Crumbling Passage and The Latch. While base churn in Fisherman’s Row moderated to three transfers over the same interval, fighting remained severe across the northern theater. Stlican Shelf logged four base exchanges in two hours as Breaker Town and Fort Hoarfrost sustained continuous pressure, maintaining a split front. Weathered Expanse similarly yielded three base shifts amidst ferocious bloodletting, claiming over 4,800 combined dead in two hours around Wightwalk and Frostmarch. Further west, Linn of Mercy flared into notable action with three base transitions and a sharp surge in Warden casualties nearing sixteen hundred in two hours, centered on Lathair and Rotdust. Nevish Line also saw casualty numbers accelerate past 2,600 in the two-hour window despite quiet base registries, whereas Mooring County and Marban Hollow lapsed into relative operational silence following their earlier upheavals.
